crossRefs.note: For before these days Theudas rose up, making himself out to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred…
After this man, Judas of Galilee rose up in the days of the enrollment, and drew away some people after him. He also…
“Blessed are you when people reproach you, persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
Being defamed, we entreat. We are made as the filth of the world, the dirt wiped off by all, even until now.

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: Aren’t you then the Egyptian, who before these days stirred up to sedition and led out into the wilderness the four thousand men of the Assassins?”
translations.bsb: “Aren’t you the Egyptian who incited a rebellion some time ago and led four thousand members of the Assassins into the wilderness?”
translations.kjv: Art not thou that Egyptian, which before these days madest an uproar, and leddest out into the wilderness four thousand men that were murderers?
translations.asv: Art thou not then the Egyptian, who before these days stirred up to sedition and led out into the wilderness the four thousand men of the Assassins?
